items.action: None. A subclass that declares its own `unslotted` no longer collides with ours.
items.appliesWhen: Only a class of yours that extends ModalComponent, ModalCardComponent or DrawerComponent. Template users need nothing; subclassing a DS component is unsupported.
items.verify: The app builds, and no subclass of ModalComponent, ModalCardComponent or DrawerComponent reads `this.unslotted`.
items.note: ModalComponent, ModalCardComponent and DrawerComponent each lost the private `unslotted`.

items.action:
Delete the `dsTooltipClippedLead` binding. A `ds-table` header with a `hint` needs nothing in its place. Where it carried other text, write it into the tooltip string as `'**' + lead + '**
' + tip`. A subclass of TooltipDirective that declared `dsTooltipClippedLead` has nothing to rename any more.
items.appliesWhen: Only an element that binds `dsTooltipClippedLead`, and a class that extends TooltipDirective. `dsTooltip`, `dsTooltipWhenClipped` and `dsTooltipTextSelector` are unchanged.
items.pitfall: Deleting the binding drops the lead line; a tooltip never adds the host's text by itself, only a `button[dsDefinitionTerm]` does.
items.verify: No template or class binds `dsTooltipClippedLead`, the app compiles, and a tooltip that used it shows its lead line, written into the string.

items.action: None, unless a tooltip string holds `**` meant literally: write `\*\*` there.
items.appliesWhen: Every `dsTooltip` string, including one a component builds from data. `dsTooltipWhenClipped` with no `dsTooltip` shows the host's text as written and is unaffected.
items.pitfall: A string with two `**` loses both and the text between them turns bold, with no error; user-supplied text reaching a tooltip needs its `**` escaped.
items.verify: Every tooltip string whose text contains `**` shows the asterisks, or bold where bold was meant.

items.action: Build after upgrading, and rename a member of yours the compiler reports as colliding.
items.appliesWhen: Only a class of yours that extends TooltipDirective or TooltipPanelComponent. Template users of dsTooltip need nothing; subclassing a DS component is unsupported.
items.pitfall: A redeclared private member collides as a public one does, and override cannot resolve it; only a rename does.
items.verify: The app builds with no member-collision error against TooltipDirective or TooltipPanelComponent.
items.note: TooltipPanelComponent gained the protected segments. TooltipDirective gained 12: contains, document, dsTooltipPinOnClick, hostPinOnClick, leadsWithOwnText, onClick, onPointerLeave, ownText, pin, pinsOnClick, pointArrowAtHost and unpin; it lost dsTooltipClippedLead.

informational: `ds-modal`, `ds-modal-card` and `ds-drawer` no longer warn in dev mode about content without a slot, or about an attribute that names no slot. That content still renders in the body. A test or screenshot that waited for the `Dev warning` toast these raised has nothing to wait for.

dsTooltipPinOnClick opens a tooltip on hover and focus with no delay and keeps it open after a click until a click outside, Escape or blur; a second click closes it. Without it a click closes the tooltip as before. While pinned the host carries data-ds-tooltip-pinned, a styling hook for the pinned trigger.

ds-info-hint (InfoHintComponent) is an info icon button: ariaLabel names it, text shows on hover and focus and stays open after a click. The icon darkens on hover, sits on a muted circle while pressed and turns accent on an --accent-muted circle while pinned.

button[dsDefinitionTerm] (DefinitionTermComponent) styles a button as a term with a dotted underline in --text-tertiary and shows its definition on hover and focus, pinned on click; [pinOnClick]="false" turns the pin off. Hover makes the underline solid, a press tints the term with --surface-muted, and a pinned term is --accent-strong on --accent-subtitle; no state changes its size.

informational.text: A ds-table header label with a hint is a button[dsDefinitionTerm]: a plain label pins its hint on click and takes the term's hover, pressed and pinned states; a sortable one sorts on click and pins nothing.
informational.verify: click a plain hinted ds-table header label, move the pointer away and confirm the hint stays open and the label shows the pinned accent until a click outside; click a sortable hinted label and confirm it sorts and no hint stays open.

informational.text: A tooltip's arrow points at the centre of its trigger when the panel is pushed off a viewport edge.
informational.verify: open a tooltip on a trigger near the left and the right viewport edge and confirm the arrow sits under the trigger's centre.

deleteList.why: ds-info-hint renders the icon button, its accessible name and the pinned tooltip.
deleteList.replaceWith: <ds-info-hint ariaLabel="..." text="..." />; keep a hand-built button whose click does something besides showing the text

deleteList.why: button[dsDefinitionTerm] carries the button reset, the dotted underline, the focus ring and the pinned tooltip.
deleteList.replaceWith: <button type="button" dsDefinitionTerm="...">; keep a dotted underline that marks something other than a term with a definition
